# FastTools

> Free online tools with no signup: YouTube channel name checker and thumbnail downloader, relationship calculators, private in-browser image converters, and crypto/developer utilities. Everything runs in the browser and is free with no account.

FastTools (https://fasttools.store) focuses on YouTube and creator utilities — its YouTube name checker and thumbnail downloader are the core of the site — plus a small set of proven everyday tools. The canonical host is the apex domain https://fasttools.store (www redirects there). All tools work on phone, tablet, and desktop. Contact: support@fasttools.store.

## YouTube & Creator Tools

- [YouTube Channel Name Checker](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/channel-checker): Check whether a YouTube channel name or @handle is already taken.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/youtube-thumbnail): Download video thumbnails in every available quality, including maxresdefault 1280x720.
- [YouTube Tag Extractor](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/youtube-tags): Extract the tags of any YouTube video, in the creator's original order.
- [YouTube Channel Name Generator](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/youtube-channel-name-generator): Generate channel name ideas by niche and style.
- [Hashtag Counter](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/hashtag-counter): Count and extract hashtags from captions for Instagram, TikTok, and X.
- [Link in Bio Generator](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/link-in-bio): Build a multi-link bio page for social profiles.
- [TikTok Engagement Calculator](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/tiktok-engagement-calculator): Calculate engagement rate from views, likes, comments, shares, and followers.
- [Influencer Rate Calculator](https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/influencer-rate-calculator): Estimate sponsorship rates across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

## Relationship & Fun Calculators

- [Anniversary Calculator](https://fasttools.store/fun-tools/anniversary): Work out exactly how long a couple has been together, with milestone dates.
- [Future Age Calculator](https://fasttools.store/fun-tools/future-age): See how old you will be in 2030, 2050, or any future year.
- [Birthday Countdown](https://fasttools.store/fun-tools/birthday-countdown): Live countdown to the next birthday in days, hours, and minutes.
- [Love Calculator](https://fasttools.store/calculator/love-calculator): Name-based compatibility score, for fun only.
- [Pregnancy Conception Calculator](https://fasttools.store/calculator/pregnancy-conception-calculator): Estimate the conception date from a due date or ultrasound data.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://fasttools.store/fun-tools/pomodoro-timer): Focus timer with ambient sounds and task tracking.

## Image Tools

- [AI Image Detector](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/ai-image-detector): Check whether a photo was generated by Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or Flux.
- [Background Remover](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/background-remover): AI background removal with transparent PNG export, processed entirely in the browser.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG privately, with no upload.
- [PNG to JPG Converter](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG to JPG with quality control; transparency is flattened to white.
- [WebP to JPG Converter](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/webp-to-jpg): Convert WebP images to universally compatible JPG.
- [JPG to PNG Converter](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG to lossless PNG in the browser.
- [Image Compressor](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/image-compressor): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP with quality and size controls.
- [Image to Text (OCR)](https://fasttools.store/image-tools/image-to-text): Extract editable text from screenshots and document photos.

## Crypto & Security Tools

- [BIP39 Mnemonic Generator](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/bip39-generator): Generate and validate 12-24 word BIP39 phrases for testing; a new phrase is always an empty wallet.
- [OTP Code Generator](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/otp-generator): TOTP codes and otpauth QR setup for two-factor authentication apps.
- [RSA Key Generator](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/rsa-generator): 2048/4096-bit RSA key pairs in PEM format, generated client-side.
- [Token Generator](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/token-generator): Cryptographically secure random tokens and API keys.
- [HMAC Generator](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/hmac-generator): Keyed signatures for API and webhook verification.
- [UUID Generator](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/uuid-generator): Bulk UUID v4 and time-ordered v7 generation.
- [Bcrypt Generator](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/bcrypt): Hash and verify passwords with adjustable cost factors.
- [Password Strength Analyzer](https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/password-strength-analyzer): Entropy and crack-time analysis using zxcvbn.

## Developer Tools

- [Regex Tester](https://fasttools.store/dev-tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions with live match and capture-group feedback.
- [MIME Types Reference](https://fasttools.store/dev-tools/mime-types): Look up MIME types and file extensions from an IANA-backed database.
- [JWT Decoder](https://fasttools.store/dev-tools/jwt-decoder): Decode JWT headers and payloads locally for debugging.
- [Hex to RGB Converter](https://fasttools.store/dev-tools/hex-to-rgb): Convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL color values.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://fasttools.store/dev-tools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix timestamps to readable dates and back.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://fasttools.store/dev-tools/json-to-csv): Convert JSON data to CSV for spreadsheets.
- [File Size Converter](https://fasttools.store/converters/file-size): Convert between bytes, KB, MB, GB, and TB, with decimal vs binary units explained.
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://fasttools.store/web-tools/whois-lookup): Domain registration, nameserver, and RDAP details.

## Finance & PDF Tools

- [PayPal Fee Calculator](https://fasttools.store/finance-tools/paypal-fee): Net payout after PayPal fees, including Goods & Services and gross-up math.
- [Bill Splitter](https://fasttools.store/finance-tools/bill-splitter): Split bills fairly with proportional tax and tip handling.
- [PDF Signature Checker](https://fasttools.store/pdf-tools/pdf-signature-checker): Check who signed a PDF, when, and whether it was modified.
- [PDF Split & Merge](https://fasttools.store/pdf-tools/pdf-splitter-merger): Split PDFs by page range or merge several into one, processed locally.

## AI Tools

- [AI Lyrics Generator](https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/lyrics-generator): Song lyric drafts by theme, genre, and mood in 40+ languages.
- [AI Caption Generator](https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/caption-generator): Platform-aware social media captions.
- [AI Pet Name Generator](https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/pet-names): Pet name ideas by species, traits, and style.
- [AI Code Detector](https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/ai-code-detector): Detect AI-generated code across 12+ languages.
- [AI Text Detector](https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/ai-text-detector): Statistical detection of AI-written text.
- [QR Code Generator](https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/qr-generator): Static QR codes that never expire.
